title: GPU Gray-QAM soft demap integration
description:
## Goal

Wrap the existing `gf2-kernels-hip::demap_batch` Gray-QAM soft-demap
kernel as a `Stage` in the gf2-sim pipeline.

## Context

Task under story `1f588e2a` (GPU stages) within epic `gf2-sim`
(`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §8 (OOM signalled, not
dispatched). The kernel + host wrapper at
`crates/gf2-kernels-hip/src/lib.rs::demap_batch` already exists.
Wave B.2 fan-out from `36075e4c`.

**AMENDMENT 2026-06-09a (user-approved, apples-to-apples perf baseline).**
The `parallelism-pays` gate compares **demap-stage throughput vs
demap-stage throughput**, NOT GPU-demap vs CPU-full-frame. The
`c0b1702d` 1.6216 fps full-frame baseline is category-confused for a
demap-only kernel. The gate divisor is the **single-thread CPU
`FastGrayQamDemapper` demap step measured in isolation** at the
matching modulation/method. Record full-frame + CPU-24-thread for
context.

**AMENDMENT 2026-06-09b (user-approved, byte-identity tolerance is a
combined abs/ulp bound).** Criterion-1's "≤ 2 ulp" cannot be a pure
value-ulp bound: the CPU `FastGrayQamDemapper` computes the max-log
distance reduction in **f64** then rounds to f32, while the GPU
computes it entirely in **f32** (design §10 f32 messages), so the two
differ by a small f32-vs-f64 residual (measured worst |diff| =
1.907e-6). The max-log LLR is a **sign-crossing** quantity, so the
value-ulp explodes near zero (where the ulp spacing collapses) even
though the absolute difference stays ≤ 1.9e-6 — and no precision
choice can bound value-ulp near a zero crossing. The byte-identity is
therefore the standard near-zero-safe **combined** bound: GPU and CPU
LLRs agree iff within **2 ulp OR within an absolute floor 2.0e-6 f32**
(the measured f32-vs-f64 distance-scale residual; worst observed
1.907e-6, recorded as a regression constant in the test). At O(1) LLR
magnitude this is exactly the 2-ulp intent; near zero the absolute
floor governs. This is the §11 SIMT-f32-vs-CPU-f64 softmath floor, not
a bug.

## Deliverables

1. `crates/gf2-sim/src/gpu/demap.rs` (under `--features hip`):
   - `pub struct GpuGrayQamDemapper { method: DemapMethod, m: u8 }`
     implementing `Stage<SymbolBatch, LlrBatch>`. The GPU kernel is
     max-log; the stage serves `MaxLog` on device and routes
     `ExactLogMap` to the CPU fallback (no fabricated GPU exact path).
   - `cpu_fallback()` returns the CPU
     `gf2_coding::modem::FastGrayQamDemapper` (via an in-crate
     `Stage` wrapper, orphan-rule, same shape as `CpuLdpcBp`).
2. Byte-identity test (under `--features hip`) in
   `tests/gpu_demap_byte_identity.rs`:
   - For 16-QAM and 64-QAM at fixed channel realisation: GPU LLR
     output matches CPU `FastGrayQamDemapper` (MaxLog) within the
     combined bound of amendment 2026-06-09b (2 ulp OR ≤ 2.0e-6
     absolute), with the measured worst-case absolute residual
     recorded as a named constant in the test source.
3. Parallelism-pays receipt entry per project plan §5 schema
   (apples-to-apples, demap-vs-demap per amendment 2026-06-09a):
   - GPU demap throughput vs **single-thread CPU
     `FastGrayQamDemapper` demap-step** baseline (≥ 5×).
   - GPU demap throughput vs CPU-24-thread demap-step baseline (for
     diagnostic comparability).
   - Record the full-frame `c0b1702d` number for context only.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] GPU demap LLRs (MaxLog) match CPU `FastGrayQamDemapper`
  within the **combined bound** of amendment 2026-06-09b — within
  2 ulp OR within 2.0e-6 f32 absolute — for 16-QAM and 64-QAM at a
  fixed channel realisation; the measured worst-case absolute residual
  is recorded in the test source as a named constant. (The pure
  value-ulp form is unachievable for a sign-crossing quantity computed
  GPU-f32 vs CPU-f64; the combined bound is the honest, measurement-
  backed equivalent of the 2-ulp intent.)
- [hard] `parallelism-pays` gate (apples-to-apples, demap-vs-demap
  per amendment 2026-06-09a): receipt records GPU demap throughput
  ≥ 5× the single-thread CPU `FastGrayQamDemapper` demap-step
  baseline (measured in isolation) AND reports the CPU-24-thread
  demap-step comparison for diagnostic value. The full-frame
  `c0b1702d` baseline is context only.
- [hard] `cpu_fallback()` returns the CPU demapper; integration
  verified by Phase B `ed575f15`.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review`, `parallelism-pays` gates green.

## Non-goals

- No new modulation orders (epic scope is 16-QAM + 64-QAM via the
  existing kernel).
- No multi-device dispatch (epic non-goal).
